$description: REFERENCE tier — what a colour IS (plans/studio-modules.md § Console tokens, DECISIONS 0438). Named by pigment + lightness step (OKLCH L × 100). Nothing outside the system tier may use these; a theme overrides them.

charcoal.$description: Studio-night grounds — warm neutrals (hue 72) so the dark reads as tinted panel, not cold UI grey.

gesso.$description: Gesso paper — warm mineral off-whites (chroma kept low so it reads clean, not cozy).

stone.$description: Mid warm neutrals — the muted and faint inks, the strong hairline.

chalk.$description: A cool white — the mark's ring on a dark ground only.

cinnabar.$description: THE pigment (docs/brand.md §2.2). 55 on paper, 66 lifted for the dark ground; 49 / 72 are the pressed states.

ochre.$description: Warm ochre — the draft / attention whisper (Law 02).

verdigris.$description: Muted verdigris — positive state and links.

brick.$description: Deeper red, held apart from cinnabar — blocked / destructive.

umber.$description: Shadow ink — light falling in a room, never a hard offset (Law 04).
